title: Majority Element
statement: Return the element that appears more than n / 2 times. The majority element always exists.
hints: A hash map count is the direct solution.
Sorting puts the majority element at index n // 2.
Boyer-Moore voting pairs the candidate against every other value. The majority cannot be cancelled completely.

approaches.name: Hash count
approaches.explanation: Return the value whose count exceeds n / 2.

editorial: Initialize candidate and count to the first element and 1. A matching value increments the count. Any other value decrements it. When the count hits zero, the next value becomes the candidate. Because a strict majority exists, it is the last candidate standing. A second pass would verify the candidate if the problem did not guarantee existence.
